title: Late Delivery Claim Delivery-Charge Refund: Entitlement and Console Action
content:
**Entitlement.** An approved Delivery Claims Late Delivery Claim on an order whose effective shipping fee and surcharge together were above 0.00 is owed a delivery-charge refund, booked as one shipping fee refund entry on the claim for the whole parcel. A claim whose effective shipping fee and surcharge were both 0.00 is owed no delivery-charge refund under this rule. Booking the entry does not by itself resolve the claim.

| Late Delivery Claim | Effective shipping fee and surcharge on the order | Delivery-charge refund owed |
|---|---|---|
| approved | together above 0.00 | yes — one shipping fee refund entry for the whole parcel |
| approved | both 0.00 | none under this rule |

Once booked, the refund stands on the claim as a compensation entry among the claim's compensation records, dated the day it was booked, with no order line and no units. The claim's status is not changed by the booking.

## Console action: `book_late_delivery_charge_refund_805d7478`

**Situation of use and capability.** Books the delivery-charge refund owed on a Late Delivery Claim as one compensation entry on that claim. One call adds a single shipping-fee-refund compensation entry, dated today, to the claim's ledger for the whole parcel (no order line, no units), carrying the amount given. Nothing else on the claim changes: its status stays as it is. The booked entry appears among the claim's compensation records, where the customer's delivery-charge refund can be seen.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `book_late_delivery_charge_refund_805d7478`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | the claim number of the Late Delivery Claim the refund is booked on, as returned by the delivery-claim lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the delivery-charge refund given on the claim, in USD | a positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places (to the nearest cent, on the final figure); stored exactly as passed |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `entry_id` (the reference of the new compensation entry), `claim_id` (the claim it was booked on), `compensation_type` (always `shipping_fee_refund`), `amount_usd` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places) and `booked_on` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving this receipt means the refund entry now stands on the claim.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a call for claim number CLM-0001 with `amount_usd` 12.40 returns a receipt naming a new entry reference, CLM-0001, `shipping_fee_refund`, 12.40 and today's date.
